profile.description: National Medical Care Company, together with its subsidiaries, owns, establishes, equips, manages, maintains, and operates healthcare facilities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also provides home health care services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

executives.name: Badr Bin Fahad M. S. Al-Athel
executives.title: Non Executive Director

finsights.brief: Trading at a low earnings multiple
Valuation implies a poor free cash flow yield

summary: Care Medical posted record Q2 revenue of SAR 456M (+15% YoY) and net profit of SAR 94M (+18% YoY), with EBITDA margin expanding to 29.5%.
Patient volumes, surgeries, and occupancy rebounded sharply after seasonal Q1 weakness from Ramadan/Eid, with occupancy reaching 84% in Q2.
Management cited encouraging July trends but cautioned Q3 typically softer due to summer holidays; major expansion projects on track for 2028-2030.
Cash conversion cycle rose to 197 days; company shifted to net debt of SAR 556M amid capital spending, with collection efforts underway.
Ongoing insurance pricing negotiations and DRG reimbursement uncertainty remain key risks; stock fell 0.7% to $113, 38% below 52-week high.
